tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and end at H = 0.48, far short of the target H = 22.3. The long-horizon probe can distinguish sustained positive gain from adaptation-driven reversal where the forecast matters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow term primarily constrains the ratio of adaptation amplitude to slow time constant. Different values of that pair can produce similar pilot fits but different long-horizon forecasts.
Finer early-time sampling does not directly measure the slow adaptation near the target horizon.
High auxiliary variance does not help identify the slow adaptation.
